_comment: Monster ability catalog — the special attacks monsters use in combat (spells, breath weapons, bites, heals). Monsters list them in `abilities` as {ability_id, cast_chance} plus optional per-monster overrides of any numeric field. `effect_type` picks the combat behavior (damage, sleep, curse, poison, heal_ally, heal_self); `damage` abilities set `damage_type`, and a `save_dc` on them gives the target a DEX save for half. See docs/data_dictionary/monster_ability.md.

monster_abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
monster_abilities.description: A crackling bolt of lightning at one target.

monster_abilities.name: Magic Dart
monster_abilities.description: A quick dart of arcane force at short range.

monster_abilities.name: Major Heal
monster_abilities.description: A powerful heal on a wounded ally.

monster_abilities.name: Self Heal
monster_abilities.description: The caster heals its own wounds.

monster_abilities.name: Spore Cloud
monster_abilities.description: A cloud of choking spores — poisons the target unless it saves.

monster_abilities.name: Haunting Wail
monster_abilities.description: A ghostly shriek that unnerves the living — weaker armor and aim for a few turns.

monster_abilities.name: Dark Slumber
monster_abilities.description: Necromantic sleep — the target drops unless it saves; tougher targets shrug it off.

monster_abilities.name: Hex
monster_abilities.description: A withering curse that saps armor and aim.

monster_abilities.name: Fireball
monster_abilities.description: A roaring ball of flame hurled at one target. DEX save for half.

monster_abilities.name: Web
monster_abilities.description: Sticky webbing pins the target (sleep) unless it saves; tougher targets break free.

monster_abilities.name: Venom Bite
monster_abilities.description: A venomous bite that poisons unless the target saves.

monster_abilities.name: Hypnotic Gaze
monster_abilities.description: A vampire's stare lulls the target to sleep unless it saves.

monster_abilities.name: Hellfire
monster_abilities.description: Demonic fire hurled at one target. DEX save for half.

monster_abilities.name: Flame Burst
monster_abilities.description: A short-range gout of flame. DEX save for half.

monster_abilities.name: Thunder Gust
monster_abilities.description: A blast of storm wind and lightning.

monster_abilities.name: Fire Breath
monster_abilities.description: A cone of dragon fire. DEX save for half.
